title: News item as it reaches the policy (synthetic illustration)
description: News enters the observation as N rows in the compact state block. This file documents the fields of one item.

underlying.description: Ticker the item is attributed to. Index-level items are mapped onto the index slot.

category.description: ea earnings, an analyst, lg legal/regulatory, ot other, gd guidance, pr product.

direction.description: Sentiment sign. '?' means the item carries no usable direction and is shown as such rather than defaulted to neutral.

horizon.description: Expected horizon in trading days, or '?' when unknown.

text.description: One-line summary, entity-masked. Anonymisation is a view layer applied on read.

available_at.description: Point-in-time stamp. A state at date t is built only from items with available_at <= t. This is the leakage boundary.

example.text: U03 reported quarterly results above consensus; management raised full-year guidance.
example._comment: SYNTHETIC. Not drawn from the corpus.
